title.zh: PostgreSQL 查询流水线与火山执行器

description.zh: 一条 SQL 依次经过 Parser、Analyzer、Rewriter、Planner 和自顶向下拉取元组的 ExecProcNode 火山执行器树。
description.en: A SQL statement passes through Parser, Analyzer, Rewriter, Planner, and the pull-based ExecProcNode Volcano iterator tree.

title.zh: PostgreSQL 代价优化器与扫描路径选择

description.zh: 规划器用 pg_statistic 直方图与 seq_page_cost / random_page_cost 对比 Seq Scan、Index Scan、Bitmap Heap Scan 与 Index-Only Scan 的总代价。
description.en: The planner weighs pg_statistic histograms with seq_page_cost and random_page_cost to pick among Seq Scan, Index Scan, Bitmap Heap Scan, and Index-Only Scan.

zh: 为什么有索引还走全表扫描
en: postgres seq scan vs index scan

title.zh: 8 KiB 分槽页与 HOT 同页更新

description.zh: PostgreSQL 每页 8,192 字节，行指针与元组相向生长；UPDATE 追加新版本不原地覆盖，仅当同页可放且未改索引列时走 HOT 免写索引。
description.en: PostgreSQL packs 8,192-byte slotted pages with downward line pointers and upward tuples; UPDATE appends new versions and only avoids index writes via same-page HOT.

zh: PostgreSQL 为什么不原地更新

description.zh: 行头携带 xmin 与 xmax，查询按轻量快照 {xmin, xmax, xip[]} 做可见性比较，区分 READ COMMITTED 与 REPEATABLE READ。
description.en: Tuple headers carry xmin and xmax so snapshots {xmin, xmax, xip[]} decide row visibility lock-free under READ COMMITTED and REPEATABLE READ.

zh: READ COMMITTED 和 REPEATABLE READ 区别
en: why readers never block writers postgres
read committed vs repeatable read postgres

title.zh: AUTOVACUUM、可见性映射与 32 位 XID 回卷

description.zh: VACUUM 清理死元组并维护支持 Index-Only Scan 的 Visibility Map，同时在 XID 跨越 2³¹ 半圈边界前将其冻结防停库。
description.en: VACUUM reclaims dead tuples, updates the Visibility Map for Index-Only Scans, and freezes ancient rows before 32-bit modular XID wraparound.

zh: 事务 ID 回卷停库

title.zh: shared_buffers 时钟扫描与双缓冲

description.zh: shared_buffers 用 usage_count 0..5 的无全局锁时钟扫描管理热页，并用 256 KiB 环形缓冲区防止全表扫描洗掉缓存。
description.en: shared_buffers uses lock-light clock-sweep eviction (usage_count 0..5) plus a 256 KiB ring buffer so bulk scans do not wipe out hot pages.

title.zh: nbtree High Key 并发分裂与右链遍历

description.zh: PostgreSQL B-Tree 通过页上界 High Key 与 btpo_next 右指针让读者并发下探免锁，并揭示 UUIDv4 随机写引起的页分裂膨胀。
description.en: PostgreSQL B-trees store High Keys and btpo_next right links for lock-free concurrent descent, showing why random UUIDv4 inserts bloat leaf pages.

zh: UUIDv4 索引膨胀 vs UUIDv7
en: postgres btree high key right link

title.zh: PostgreSQL 连接策略与 work_mem 磁盘溢出

description.zh: 当 Hash Join 建表内存超出每算子 work_mem 上限时，PostgreSQL 自动切换多批 Grace Hash 并把分区写入 pgsql_tmp 临时文件。
description.en: When a hash build table exceeds per-operator work_mem, PostgreSQL partitions into multi-batch Grace Hash spills inside pgsql_tmp.

zh: Nested Loop vs Merge Join vs Hash Join
en: nested loop vs hash join vs merge join

title.zh: PostgreSQL WAL、CRC-32C 与全页写防撕裂

description.zh: 提交先顺序刷 WAL 并靠全页写（FPW）记录检查点后的首次整页 8 KiB 镜像，防止断电导致 4 KiB 扇区撕裂半页损坏。
description.en: Commits flush sequential WAL protected by Castagnoli CRC-32C and log full 8 KiB page images after checkpoints to survive 4 KiB torn writes on crash.

title.zh: PostgreSQL 18 异步 I/O、19 在线重构与 pgvector HNSW
title.en: PostgreSQL 18 AIO, 19 REPACK & pgvector HNSW Frontier

description.zh: PostgreSQL 18 引入 io_method 异步 I/O 与 B-Tree 跳跃扫描，19 新增在线 REPACK (CONCURRENTLY)，pgvector 将 HNSW 向量图直接集成进共享缓冲区与 WAL。
description.en: PostgreSQL 18 brings io_method AIO and B-tree skip scans, PostgreSQL 19 adds online REPACK (CONCURRENTLY), and pgvector integrates HNSW graphs inside Postgres pages.

description.en: Three diagnostic checks for slow or bloated PostgreSQL queries: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), pinned xmin/dead tuples, and splits/FPW spikes.
